## Invitations

A total of 6749 invitations were issued during the reporting period. Attendance was recorded for 5032 people, representing a rate of 74.6 per cent. The results indicate that most invited people attended, while a smaller proportion did not attend. The invitation activity and attendance figures will support ongoing monitoring of outreach performance and help inform future communication planning.

## Contact

SMS contact was used for 5733 invitations. A reminder was also sent to 5733 people. Using both initial contact and reminder messaging provided a consistent approach to communicating with invitees and supporting attendance. The contact figures will be reviewed alongside attendance outcomes to assess the contribution of messaging to the overall response.

The outreach activity has been documented for routine reporting. Further follow-up and review will continue through established processes, with attention given to people who did not attend. This report was prepared by G. Evans.
